schema.description:
Plaintext (`encryption` omitted or `none`; `content` and/or
`attachmentUrl`) or end-to-end encrypted (`encryption: v1`
with `encryptedPayload`, no `content`). A `v1` message is only
allowed in private conversations and needs one wrapped key for
each of the two participants at their latest key versions
(400 `errors.invalidEncryptedMessage` if malformed; 409
`errors.e2eRecipientHasNoKey` / `errors.e2eKeyVersionStale`
so the client can refetch keys and retry). Its optional
`attachmentUrl` must be an `/uploads/<uuid>.bin` blob from
`POST /api/uploads/encrypted`; a plaintext message can never
use one (400 `errors.invalidChatAttachment`).

encryptedPayload.description: Envelope of an end-to-end encrypted message. The server validates its shape and key versions, never the ciphertext.
encryptedPayload.title: E2eMessagePayloadV1

replyToMessageId.description: The id of an existing message in this conversation.
